extracted.name: Hot Italian Sausage
extracted.description: This hot Italian sausage recipe uses ground pork seasoned with paprika, garlic salt, anise, fennel, and red pepper, perfect for meatballs or burgers.
instruction_lines: Combine pork, paprika, garlic salt, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl; set aside.
Place oil, anise seed, fennel seed, and red pepper flakes into a blender or food processor; blend well. Pour over pork mixture and mix until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate until flavors blend, about 24 hours. Freeze sausage in resealable plastic bags in desired portions.
